review_label: beta16 refresh review of the existing public release
result: PASS for the observed refresh and menu flows; earlier blank-menu screenshot interpretation corrected

independent_saved_image_review.method: Open saved files with view_image; independently decode all JPEGs with Pillow and compare SHA256 hashes
visible_content_in_full_image: Pocket Kingdoms branding and settlement illustration
New solo and Play online buttons
Settings, Updates and Full screen controls
independent_saved_image_review.presentation_discrepancy: The original saved reproduction and first repeat capture displayed the complete menu to this reviewer. In a later batch, the first image displayed fully while byte-identical second and third images appeared as tiny green patches in the tool presentation. Therefore the tiny patch is not the content of those saved JPEG files.
independent_saved_image_review.capture_provenance_limit: The root agent performed the browser actions and saved the captures. This review independently inspected file contents; byte equality alone does not prove three separate reloads occurred.

browser_checks_reported_by_root_agent.observed: New solo opened correctly; Back returned to the menu.
Resume restored the paused old checkpoint with 280 food, 310 wood, 130 gold and population 7/15. Save and exit returned to the menu with the 0:31 checkpoint.
Canvas backing and DOM rectangle were both exactly 844x390; toolbar placement was normal; browser warnings and errors were empty.

correction.prior_claim: A blank green Godot menu after Refresh was treated as a possible product rendering defect.
correction.updated_assessment: The saved evidence contains the complete menu, and repeated refreshes preserved functional menu and resume behavior. The earlier screenshot-based claim is a false positive for these observations and should not remain listed as a known product defect.
correction.uncertainty: The exact tool/UI presentation failure is not diagnosed. This does not rule out unrelated rendering defects on other devices or establish physical installed-PWA coverage.
correction.rejected_experiment: A temporary startup backing-width transition was not accepted and was reverted. No redraw nudge or rendering workaround was added on the basis of these captures.

remaining_validation: Root agent will repeat refresh checks after deployment. These captures test public beta15.1, not a later beta16 runtime.
